content.rendered:
Promenade Beach, also known as Rock Beach, is a 1.2 kilometer long stretch of beach in the city of Puducherry, India. It’s a popular destination for locals and tourists, known for its scenic beauty, rocky shoreline, and iconic monuments.

When to visit:

  • The best time to visit is during the winter season, from October to March
  • The beach is open from 6 AM to 10 PM

What to see and do:

  • Walk: Stroll along the beach and enjoy the sea breeze
  • Watch the sunrise and sunset: Take in the picturesque views of the sky and water
  • Play sports: Try volleyball, jogging, skating, yoga, or swimming
  • Shop: Visit the local vendors for handicrafts
  • Explore the monuments: See the iconic monuments that add to the beach’s charm

Where to stay:

  • The Promenade is a hotel located right on the beach that offers a restaurant, spa, and nightclub
  • There are also spa hotels and corner hotels nearby

Other attractions

  • War Memorial
  • Chief Secretariat
  • Mahatma Gandhi statue
  • Dupleix Park

Tips

  • Do not venture too deep into the sea, especially during the monsoons.
  • Don’t forget to apply sunscreen on the exposed areas of your skin.
  • Vehicle entry is banned on the beachfront in the evening.
